Title: Manufacturing solutions with AI in factories

Body.Content:
Manufacturing customers,  modernize your factory floors and get started with the intelligent edge using an artificial intelligence (AI) solution that combines the power of Azure Stack Hub and Azure Stack Edge with computer vision.

Learn more.
